name: Desktop scripts
description: The helpers the Hyprland binds call: mic mute with a toast, touchpad lock state, OCR and translate a screen region, swap warning, Zoom mouse mode, the recorder keep-alive, the random-wallpaper wrapper around caelestia, the sleep hook, and clipboard history services.
notes: Optional OCR engine for kibby-screen-text: `uv tool install rapidocr` (otherwise it uses tesseract).
